name: qbeta-admissible-line-exhausts-the-choice
description: Enumerates the functional-choice space for Q_beta = |eps(Delta)|*E0. The normalised admissible traces of H_3(q) form a ONE-PARAMETER line phi_beta = (1-2b)*chi_(3) + b*chi_(2,1); the value map onto both candidate Delta is affine with slope b - 2a, which is exactly the scalar-mod-radical residual and has no root at any q > 1. So the map is SURJECTIVE: every target is hit by exactly one beta. Two points of the line are Markov (z = q at beta = 0, z_D at beta = q^2/(q^2+1)^2), giving +12.470 % / -43.157 % on Delta_S and +39.324 % / -15.451 % on Delta_L; the beta reproducing CODATA is neither. Relaxing from Markov traces to general admissible traces therefore buys one free parameter and no content. The published 0.17 % sits at z = 1, whose chi_(1^3) coefficient is nonzero.

assertions.name: markov_trace_decomposes_uniquely_in_the_character_basis
assertions.detail: 6 equations, 3 unknowns -- a unique consistent solution is itself the check that tr_M is a trace

assertions.name: admissibility_numerator_is_exactly_the_known_quadratic
assertions.detail: chi_(1^3) coefficient numerator = q**2*(-q + z)*(-q**3 + q**2*z + z) = q^2*(z - q)*((q^2+1)z - q^3) identically -- the admissibility condition N(q,z) = 0 of the 2026-08-29 audit, re-derived here from the character decomposition rather than assumed

assertions.name: z_equals_one_is_inadmissible
assertions.detail: C(1) = q**2*(q - 1)*(q**3 - q**2 - 1)/((q**2 + 1)*(q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)), nonzero for q > 1 -- the published closed form's functional leaks into the (1^3) block that the GNS/TL quotient kills

assertions.name: the_normalised_admissible_family_is_ONE_parameter
assertions.detail: phi_beta(1) = (1-2b)*chi_(3)(1) + b*chi_(2,1)(1) = (1-2b) + 2b = 1 for every beta -- so after normalisation the admissible trace space is a LINE, parameterised by beta

assertions.name: the_two_markov_points_sit_at_beta_0_and_beta_D
assertions.detail: z = q  ->  beta = 0 (the augmentation, chi_(3) itself); z = z_D  ->  beta = q**2/(q**2 + 1)**2

assertions.name: markov_points_are_normalised_so_they_lie_ON_the_line
assertions.detail: a + 2b = 1 at both admissible z, so both Markov points are already normalised -- the line is the right ambient family

assertions.name: value_map_is_affine_in_beta_with_slope_b_minus_2a
assertions.detail: phi_beta(Delta) = chi_(3)(Delta) + beta*(chi_(2,1) - 2*chi_(3))(Delta) -- affine in beta, verified on the coordinate vector

assertions.name: slope_is_nonzero_for_both_elements_at_every_q_greater_1
assertions.detail: the slope is exactly the scalar-mod-radical residual b - 2a, whose only positive root is the degenerate q = 1 -- so on the physical branch EVERY value is reachable by exactly one beta

assertions.name: beta_star_is_NEITHER_markov_point_for_either_element
assertions.detail: the 4 beta values reproducing CODATA (two sign branches x two elements) are all distinct from beta = 0 (z = q) and beta = 0.247297886748 (z = z_D) -- so NO admissible Markov trace reproduces the Q-value on either candidate element

assertions.name: EVERY_target_is_hit_by_exactly_one_beta_so_the_family_is_a_fit
assertions.detail: solving phi_beta(Delta) = t for a SYMBOLIC target t gives exactly one beta on each element ({'Delta_S': 1, 'Delta_L': 1}) -- 'some other admissible functional works' is true but empty: one parameter, one anchor, zero predictive content. Removing the parameter needs functional-independence, which both elements fail at every q > 1

assertions.name: the_published_value_sits_at_the_inadmissible_z_equals_1
assertions.detail: tr_M(z=1)(Delta_S) is 0.16775687 % from CODATA -- the published 0.17 %, reproduced here from the character decomposition rather than from the closed form

caveats: Admissibility here means annihilating the (1^3) block, i.e. the GNS/TL quotient under convention D. The line is the normalised trace space of that quotient, not of H_3(q).
Surjectivity is a statement about the FAMILY, not an endorsement: a beta chosen to hit the anchor is a fit with one parameter and one datum, which is why beta* is reported and not adopted.

Delta_L's characters are extracted by inverting its two admissible Markov evaluations rather than from a coordinate vector; the extraction is calibrated by reproducing chi_(2,1)(Delta_S) = 0 in the sibling probe.
Nothing here is wired to production. The bean's decision is unchanged by this probe -- it closes an option, it does not pick one.
q0AnchorReason: The character decomposition, the admissibility roots and the surjectivity argument are exact over Q(q) and pin-free; q0 enters only to evaluate T = Q_codata/E0 and print the comparison cells.
